description: This file implements the HealthcheckService class, which manages periodic health checks (pings) to servers, handles acknowledgments, and manages server state changes based on ping responses. It includes methods for sending pings, handling ping sent and acknowledgment received events, and removing servers from the check list.

classes.name: HealthcheckService
classes.description: A service class responsible for performing periodic health checks (pings) to servers, handling responses, and managing server states.

methods.name: HealthcheckService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the health check timer if the interval is non-zero.

methods.name: ~HealthcheckService
methods.description: Destructor that cancels and resets the health check timer if active.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server, verifying the ping ID and tracking the server.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment reception from a server, verifying ping ID, removing server from pending list, and updating server state if acknowledgment indicates failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Removes a server from the pending pings list when the server is removed.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends a ping to all remaining servers, handles timeout logging, clears the list, generates a new ping ID, and initiates the next ping cycle.
